name: @tetherto/mdk-plugin-mvp-site-mcp
description: Agent-contract MCP tools: closed-vocabulary, summary-first site queries and actions for the MDK agent, via the MDK protocol client over the RPC listener.

tools.description: How the site is doing right now: worker and device totals, how many are online, and which are not.

agent.answers: How many workers and devices exist and how many are online.
notFor: any reading, metric, power figure, energy use or cost — this tool holds none of them
agent.returns: counts of workers and devices by family and state, plus the ids of anything offline. Inventory only: no readings, no power, no energy and no cost figures

tools.description: How many devices match a family and a readiness state.

agent.answers: How many devices there are, by family and state.
agent.returns: a single count with a one-line summary

tools.description: Which devices match a family and a readiness state, named individually.

agent.answers: Which devices match a family and state.
agent.returns: the matching devices, one per line, with a one-line summary

tools.description: What one named device reports or supports: its live readings, its state, the commands it accepts, or the power modes it allows.

agent.answers: One attribute of one named device.
useWhen: what can I do to this device
notFor: anything across several devices (use list_devices or rank_devices)
agent.returns: the requested attribute with a one-line summary

tools.description: Devices of a family ordered by a metric, highest or lowest first.

agent.answers: Which devices lead or trail on a metric.
useWhen: which miner has the lowest power
agent.returns: an ordered list with the metric value, and a one-line summary

tools.description: Perform an action on one named device. Requires operator approval before it runs.

agent.answers: A state-changing action on one device.
agent.returns: the outcome of the action with a one-line summary
